Official Notice

13 October 2025

Hello farmers! We'll be testing some improvements designed to make your farming experience smoother and more rewarding.

Production Time Rebalance test

We've adjusted production times for many of your farm's products. Some items will now be ready faster, while a few may take a bit longer.

You'll also notice small changes to the instant completion cost for Diamonds, their value in the Roadside Shop, and the coin & XP rewards for the tasks that require these products. These updates help keep everything balanced while making production more fun and efficient.

Here's an example of what you might see:

<example witrh Blueberry Muffins here>

This change will first be tested with a small group of players. If everything goes well, we'll roll it out to everyone soon.
